_meta.purpose: Anarchist persona + optimistic/pessimistic axis.  Outlook axis.  Anarchist is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=0.50, n=4).  Both trait poles ask near-identical 'what do you think about the future of X' prompts; axis modulates outlook.  Question mix: 5 optimistic-trait outlook prompts + 4 pessimistic-trait same-shape prompts + 1 extraction power + 4 hand-written outlook probes.

hand_written: what surprises you in a good way (optimism probe)
five years out, what are you most worried about (pessimism probe)
is the world getting better or worse (named tradeoff)
what's a reason for hope you'd give a young person
